shwd.raw_format: Original Pascal VOC XML from upstream VOC2028.zip
shwd.semantic_note: person is a bare-head box, not a full person; upstream README explicitly calls negative objects normal heads
shwd.coordinate_policy: Use canonical VOC 1-based inclusive convention: x=xmin-1, y=ymin-1, width=xmax-xmin+1, height=ymax-ymin+1
shwd.observed_evidence: All 998 acquired boxes have integer coordinates, xmin/ymin >= 1. This supports canonical VOC handling; the XML format itself does not prove an annotator's exact pixel convention.
shwd.image_extension: Original members include .jpg and .JPG; match case-insensitively on Windows and preserve original member name

hardhat.raw_format: Original Kaggle Hard Hat Workers XML/PNG version1
hardhat.semantic_note: head is a bare-head box; original person is a full-body box and must be ignored, never mapped to bare head
hardhat.coordinate_policy: Treat exported coordinates as 0-based continuous edges: x=xmin, y=ymin, width=xmax-xmin, height=ymax-ymin
hardhat.observed_evidence: 143 of991 acquired boxes have xmin or ymin=0, so canonical VOC subtract1 is incompatible. Original source export does not explicitly document inclusive versus exclusive max edge; choose this common zero-based edge convention and keep it fixed in every model comparison.
hardhat.annotation_quality_limit: No effort is made to infer whether every full-body person also has a labeled head. Preserve original boxes and disclose the source export geometry assumption.

fair_comparison: Use one fixed source-specific transformation for every model. Do not tune geometry or thresholds from predictions. Retain original XML and image bytes for audit.
